Class SpatialHeatmapColorPalette

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.heatmap.SpatialHeatmapColorPalette
public final class SpatialHeatmapColorPalette extends Object

Spatial Heatmap Color Palette

Evaluates raster and vector cell attributes, normalizes values across thematic domains (Physical, Demographics, Ecology, Mining, Society invalid input: '&' Politics), and computes Moran's I spatial autocorrelation coefficient.

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • computeMoranI

      public static double computeMoranI(List<H3Cell> cells, DisplayMode mode)
      Computes Moran's I spatial autocorrelation coefficient for the grid: $$I = \frac{N}{W} \frac{\sum_i \sum_j w_{ij}(x_i - \bar{x})(x_j - \bar{x})}{\sum_i (x_i - \bar{x})^2}$$
      Parameters:
      cells - cell population
      mode - display mode channel
      Returns:
      Moran's I coefficient in range [-1.0, 1.0]
